Children inside parents and parent sum equals children sum in the readout; good probe.

Before/after difference reads, but the pad shifts the synthetic "after" points (an input-data knob) and the centre position is an empty all-grey map. Fix: probe a cell to show its before and after counts, keep the shift as a slider.

Points coloured by lake read, but the pointer is outside every lake at most positions and the single placed point is tiny (2 distinct pictures). Fix: rest inside a lake and light every point in the hovered zone.
Only a small marker moves (0.5%); the hovered cell is not lit and the picture is the same as cell-geometry. Fix: highlight the hovered cell and its points.
Cap covering on several faces is abstract (colours unexplained), but the cap radius follows the reach and cell count changes a lot.
Six seeds with child-in-parent squares; probe lifts one seed, little else changes.

Outline-only hull and footprint; the intersection polygon follows the drag.

Sorted values, break rules and class bars read together; the pad changes method and class count.

Speckled flash scatter in categorical colours says little about a colour scale; y (scale) has no effect and 3 of 5 positions are distinct. Fix: show the ramp against a sorted value strip and make the second axis act.

Box and histogram are legible, but moving the box changes under 2% and the masked histogram is nearly the full one. Fix: contrast the masked rows' histogram against the total in a second colour on a fixed axis.
Quantile curve with a range box; the window moves the kept range and the map dims the rest.
Tract choropleth with an aim arrow toward an indicator; weights shift visibly.
Ten tiny unlabelled thumbnails and a tract mosaic; the playhead selects a frame. Fix: one large capture with the thumbnails as the time strip.
Rows of unlabelled bars and two big teal bars; hover only adds a dashed outline (x 0%, 3 distinct). Fix: highlight the hovered pass across both charts with a value rule, and label units.
Abstract node graph plus timeline without labels; hovering outlines one node and the readout barely changes ("source none" everywhere). Fix: light the hovered node's resources on the timeline.
Graph with scope colours; the probe draws a dashed link from node to its scope.
Same pairs and same flat curve as variogram (same pair counts); nothing shows two variables. Fix: plot both variables' marks and the cross semivariance against each single variogram.

Shift arrows on a Midwest grid are tiny; placing a test point moves one arrow (0.5%) and maximumIterations is inert. Fix: enlarge the shift field (colour by magnitude) and draw the interpolating grid cell around the test point.
Tract choropleth with block dots; hover outlines the tract and shows its blocks, change under 2%.
Choropleth with a tiny Lorenz inset; hover gives the Atkinson index of a tract, the inset is too small to read.
Mostly grey map where matched and unmatched blocks are hard to tell apart. Fix: colour matched blocks by joined value and unmatched in one clear neutral.
Sample circles and K/g/mark curves; radius rule and circles follow, y does nothing.
Eight points with small rings fill 2% of the frame at rest. Fix: more points and a larger rest radius so the buffers and their overlaps read.
Quadrat heat map with points; probe reports nearest-neighbour and quadrat counts.
Placed slump lights changed cores under the ring; good place gesture.
Orange and blue speckle over the tile; linearity, planarity and scatter cannot be read from the colours. Fix: colour by dominant feature on a tile with roofs and edges, with a three-colour key.

Swipe doubles as a threshold that barely changes the classification (7710 to 7663 of 9000), and slope and maximumThreshold are inert. Fix: a pure curtain, or a level gesture on a tile with intermediate relief (WEB-PIC-09).

Dim speckle; the probe reads "height 0.00 (0 m)" at all three positions shown, most likely because it lands on ground points. Fix: colour points by normalized height on a visible ramp and rest the probe on a tree.
Uniform speckle where source and target clouds cannot be told apart; only a small RMSE curve changes. Fix: two contrasting colours, fewer points, correspondence lines and the aligned result.
Uniform orange speckle at rest; the float32 quantization grid only appears at the far end of the pad. Fix: zoom in and draw the plain cast against the local positions in two colours.
Speckled tile; the hovered point gets a tiny ring and 3 to 8 neighbours that cannot be seen. Fix: an enlarged inset of the neighbourhood, or brighter linked points with spokes.
Surface left and classified points right read as a curtain; the threshold the swipe also drives barely changes ground (7712 to 7685) and window is inert.

Rejected points are a few red dots among orange; the level ticks move but the picture has 2 distinct states (threshold settles, x 0%). Fix: per-frame threshold on the computed distances and rejected points drawn large and bright.
Canopy surface against terrain as a curtain is clear; readout gives canopy height under the hand.
Sparse dots on black; tiles, voxels and the merge are invisible and the seam drag changes 3%. Fix: colour points by source tile, draw voxel cells and highlight shared voxels on the seam.
Sample circles and G, F, J curves with a radius rule.
Observed L curve far above an envelope that collapses to a flat line, so the envelope is unreadable; radius reach works.
Same layout and same circles as ripley-envelope and ripley-distance-functions. Fix: draw K against the Poisson reference pi r squared to separate it from the siblings.
Scale curve with a clamp knee; the pad moves domain and range.
Fifteen small thumbnails and a slot strip; the frame box moves along. Fix: show the selected snapshot large.
Abstract graph and two small maps; picking the tapped iteration changes little (3 of 5 distinct). Fix: show the tapped view large and diff it against the final result.

Full-frame contour surface without axes, the raw points squeezed into a corner; at the right end of the pad a blocky band appears at the edge. Fix: axes for lag and distance and a smaller surface panel.
Distance band circle and Moran bars with z line; probe moves the band.
A dim diagonal of cells on black; most of the frame is empty. Fix: fit the active time range to the frame and use a brighter ramp.
Flashes inside the time window light, histogram box follows; clear.
Blocks selected under the ring transfer to tracts in yellow; clear.
Raw against standardized as a curtain, but the histogram is a single orange bar. Fix: histogram of z-scores with a zero line and the raw histogram beside it.
Pairs at the hovered lag and semivariance bars; works but bars are nearly flat.
Fitted model curves read; hovering only moves a rule (0.8%) and the map beside it is empty. Fix: show the pairs at the hovered distance on the map as variogram does.
Tracts against nine target zones as a curtain; the zones are huge blocks running off the frame, but source and target read.

Regions are colourful and clear; the iteration playhead snaps to three builds and the regions barely change between them. Fix: show the swaps per iteration (moved tracts outlined) or an objective trace.
Class map with histogram and break rule; sliding a break reassigns tracts.

Noisy field with small conditioning points; playing replicates changes the whole field, conditioning is hard to see.

Both populations (65+ and under 65) draw as similar orange dots on black. Fix: two contrasting dot colours and a brighter dot size.
Focal field fills the frame; the window disc hides the cells under it, radius and position follow the hand.
A small point cluster at the top with overlapping ellipses fills 2% of the frame. Fix: fit the points and ellipses to the frame and dim the extra standard-deviation rings.
The estimated intensity is not drawn, only tinted points and a corner chart. Fix: draw the kernel intensity as a raster under the points.
Kriged surface, samples and a range ring that follows the reach; clear.
Line density cells along routes; probe reports length over area per cell.

Hovered cell's neighbours drawn as spokes with the estimate and error; clear.

Interpolated hull with samples; carrying one sample changes the surface locally.
Picked rows light inside the ring; small change.
Event density cells; probe reads one cell's count.
Bare curves with no shaded envelope and no points map; only the rule moves (0.9%). Fix: shade the envelope band, mark where observed leaves it, show the pattern.

Random points coloured by tract; hover outlines a tract.
Tangled routes; hover lights one line and its points.

Star lasso over points; carrying it counts points inside.
Regions with a spotlight; pseudo-F is constant (a partition score), the lone bar at the corner is bare.
Same scene as readback with a value bar chart; works.
Region circle with histogram readback; the histogram follows the window.
Leg directions and a rose; pointing at a direction lights the legs in that sector.
Spanning tree cuts and regions change strongly with the pad; clear.

Sample points and population are both small yellow dots; moving the split changes nothing visible ("west 60 east 100" at every split). Fix: colour the two strata and sampled points distinctly, and recount per stratum as the split moves.
Map with four conditional matrices; hover frames the lag-class matrix.
Tree over tracts with the hovered tract's tree edges against its neighbours; clear.
Unlabelled matrices and bars; raising the threshold only adds stripes on sparse rows (2.9%). Fix: grey out sparse rows in the matrix and show the count against the threshold on a labelled bar.
Map and matrix; hovering a matrix cell lights its tracts.
Regions read, but walking the merges changes 3% and only small regions merge between the three builds. Fix: outline the two regions merged at each step and step through every merge.
Tract choropleth with block dots in the hovered tract; same layout as group-statistics.

Buffer outline around two lines reads, but the reach gives 0.090, 0.085, 0.083 at three positions (0.5% change) because every test position sits at a similar distance. Fix: map the reach over a wider range (log) so the edge visibly follows the hand.

Building outlines only, in a strip at the top; no adjacency or terrace link is drawn, and two of three positions read "no building hovered". Fix: draw shared walls as links, fit the block to the frame and snap the probe to the nearest building.
Territories around buildings re-form as one is dragged; outlines only.
Hull and points read, but carrying one of hundreds of points barely moves the hull (0.5%). Fix: let the reach set maximumCircumradius, or carry a hull vertex outward.
Six triangulated rings; dragging one vertex changes one small shape (0.4%) and constraint edges are not distinguished from free edges.
Coverage outlines read; two of three positions show "(no readout)" and the dissolved district highlight is faint. Fix: snap the probe to the nearest tract and fill the dissolved district.
Constructed jagged coverage; tolerance follows the reach and shared edges stay shared.
Grey coverage with a few orange invalid edges; gap stays 0.012 and the picture changes 0.3%. Fix: mark the gaps and overlaps as filled red slivers and let the reach set gapWidth across them.
Circles over faint tracts; iterations 5, 20 and 50 look almost the same. Fix: start the relaxation from overlapping centroid circles and draw displacement tails.
Arcs to a placed destination re-draw clearly; the base map is very faint.
Hex grid over faint points; sliding the origin moves an identical lattice. Fix: count points per generated cell and colour the cells so moving the origin changes the result.
Group hulls read; carrying one point changes nothing visible (2 distinct, 0.2%). Fix: carry a whole group or drive the circumradius by reach.
Group hulls read; the carried point stays inside its hull at most positions (3 distinct). Fix: carry a hull vertex so the hull visibly re-forms.
Standard-deviation ellipses run far off the frame and overlap the bounding boxes in a tangle. Fix: clip to the frame, show one group bright and the rest dim.
Moving the viewpoint redraws the isovist against the buildings; clear.
Chunk colours change with the reach; lines are thin.
Clipped pieces inside polygons are coloured; dragging shifts the polygon layer.
Located points along routes follow the measure offset.
Hover lights one merged chain and its fragments.
Inserted vertices are tiny dots that cannot be seen at card size; the picture changes 0.2%. Fix: draw original vertices large and inserted ones in a second colour.
Original (dashed, faint) against simplified lines; the three positions keep 15, 19 and 15 vertices and look alike (0.4%). Fix: widen the tolerance range and brighten the original.
Smoothed against original lines; the ratio changes but the curves look alike (2.1%). Fix: show the original angular line in a contrasting colour and allow more iterations.
Crossing lines split into coloured pieces; reads as a coloured grid, dragging re-splits.
Faint roads with tiny measure ticks; moving the query point changes 0.4% (3 distinct). Fix: draw the projection from the query point to the road and the measure along it.
Four-colour map is clear; the probe outlines a tract and its neighbours, x and y change near 0%.
Offset against input line; the distance follows the side and reach.
Abstract bars mapping fixes to vessels with no labels. Fix: label the two strips and draw the expansion as arrows between them.
Blue discs with no visible input points; the reach returns the same 0.100 at two of three positions. Fix: draw the input points and the outline edge distinctly and widen the range.

Shows a line-simplified shoreline whose tolerance lives in a GPUParameterBuffer; nothing in the picture says the value is written per frame without recompiling. The reach saturates at the 0.1 maximum at every test position ("tolerance 0.100 · kept 9" throughout) because the pointer is never within 0.1 of the shore. Fix: map the reach logarithmically from the shore so the full range is reachable, and show a frame counter against a "compiled once" badge.
Intersections of two layers fill as the orange layer is dragged; clear.
Same picture and same drag as constrained-delaunay-triangulation; one vertex moves (0.4%). Fix: a different input (a polygon with holes from real data) and an edge-type encoding.
Assembled rings and input segments are both thin blue lines; hovering lights one joint (1.8%). Fix: colour each assembled ring and show the dangling input segments distinctly.
Generated circles at vessel positions over faint tracks, cut off at the top. Fix: fit to frame and show the vessel the shape is generated for.
Shared stretches between routes light as the departure point moves.
Street profile samples between facades; two of three positions read "no facade in reach". Fix: constrain the probe to the street axis and rest on a sample with facades.
Visibility graph with the hovered node's visible links; dense grey background graph.
Transformed rings are white over faint originals, hard to tell apart; the aim arrow rotates and scales them clearly.
Selected polygons fill inside the moving box; clear window.
Small mixed glyphs with tolerance circles; what "equal" means is not visible at rest. Fix: pair each input with its canonical twin and tick the equal pairs.
Equal pairs turn blue as the tolerance loosens; tolerance circles add clutter.
Skeletons and offset rings in small shapes; the reach changes the offset visibly.
Destination fan around a placed origin on a faint world map; follows the hand.
Geodesics to cities from a placed target; the faint map makes the arcs float.
Grid-snapped coastline against the faint input; the reach changes gridSize strongly. Near duplicate of line-precision-reduction.
Parcels filled by area; dragging a corner reshapes one parcel and the readout follows.
Thin rings with tiny direction arrows; the curtain shows "14 rings reversed" at every position. Fix: draw large winding arrows and colour clockwise against counter-clockwise.
Coloured outlines with no key for which predicate each colour means; hover lights one shape.
Faint rings in many colours; invalid shapes and the reason are not marked at rest. Fix: mark the invalid location (self-intersection point, wrong winding) on each shape.
Label points in crescent shapes read; refinement rounds move them imperceptibly (distance 0.052 to 0.047). Fix: draw the candidate search grid for each round.
Faint input with small loops under a white output; the readout stays "240 -> 129" at every position. Fix: draw removed loops in red and let the drag create a loop.
Crossing lines with coloured pieces; the readout stays "101 noded segments · 94 splits" and nodes are not marked. Fix: draw node dots and recount as the crossing moves.
Grid-snapped line follows the reach; sibling of geometry-cleanup.
Projected Europe grid changes with the origin latitude; x does nothing.
Abstract date-line diagram; the dragged polygon reads "whole" at every position and never shows a split. Fix: rest across the antimeridian and draw the split pieces.
Bow-tie rings are repaired as a vertex is dragged across; the bow-ties are small.
Circles in thin shapes; pushing the boundary changes the circle very little (0.7%). Fix: larger shapes and a drag that visibly narrows the shape.
Circle, rectangle and diameter per shape; pulling a vertex updates all three.
Clearance is a tiny white tick on filled shapes; squeezing a vertex changes 0.5%. Fix: draw the clearance segment large with its two end points and colour shapes by clearance.
Tiny glyphs of mixed types; hover draws a dashed link from input to canonical (1.4%). Fix: two aligned columns, input and canonical, with the hovered pair enlarged.
Start-vertex dots are barely visible; the aim moves the input start and the readout says "canonical start fixed" every time. Fix: draw the input and canonical start vertices large in two colours.
Offset components around a river line; two of three positions give the same distance and joinStyle is inert. Fix: widen the reach range and show the components in separate colours.
Grid-snapped polygons against the faint grid; the reach changes gridSize.
Faces are outlines only and the readout stays "6 faces" as the crossing moves. Fix: fill each face in its own colour so the drag visibly re-forms them.
Hull tightens and loosens with the level; clear.
Clipped lines and polygons inside the moving rectangle; clear.
Crossings marked as dots; moving the crossing keeps "28 crossings" and changes 0.1%. Fix: drag one whole line so crossings appear and disappear.
Snapped line with reference dots; the readout says "left out" at most positions (3 distinct). Fix: draw the snap tolerance ring and the inserted vertex.
Slivers turn orange as the threshold rises; the value axis is bare.
A thin window outline and three unlabelled bars; at the far drag the bars overlap the window. Fix: fit the window, label the bars and keep them clear of the geometry.
Subdivided pieces read; pushing a vertex keeps "4 pieces" and changes 1%. Fix: let the gesture set maximumVertices or drag a vertex that adds pieces.
Skeleton and offset rings; two of three positions give the same offset (3 distinct). Fix: map the reach over the full depth of the shape.
Snapped vertices in orange against inputs; the snap radius follows.
Sparse matrix with no network beside it; hovering draws a dashed crosshair and a link count (1.2%). Fix: an inset network with the hovered rows' and columns' nodes and links lit.
Unlabelled full-frame matrix; input order reads as noise and the five bands are not marked. Fix: draw band boundaries and a node strip coloured by band.
Three alternative routes to a placed target re-route clearly.
Hovering a facility draws links to the demand it serves with its load.
Demand dots and one dashed arc; the catchment itself is not filled and dragging changes 1.7%. Fix: colour network edges or demand by accessibility within the catchment.
Catchments drawn as Euclidean dashed circles over the street network, not as network-shaped bands; cluttered. Fix: colour edges by drive-time band from the dragged facility.
Bundling tightens across iterations; clear and attractive.
Closing the hovered site recolours its demand; small change (0.6%).
Zone flows as arrows over a heat grid; dense grey flow lines behind.
Demand dots coloured by most likely facility; dragging one changes under 1% and probabilities are drawn as hard classes. Fix: tint dots by probability for the dragged facility.
Facilities with coverage rings; the reach gives coverage 0.10, 0.10, 0.15 (3 distinct) and covered share 14 to 17%. Fix: widen the coverage range and light covered demand.

Edges tinted by accessibility; dragging a facility changes 1.3% with a Euclidean dashed ring. Fix: make the dragged facility's contribution visible (edge colour change near it).
Components coloured; probe lights one component with its size.
Dim purple betweenness; the reach sets the cost limit and the map empties at small limits.
Original network, super-edges and grid lines overlap in a cluttered tangle. Fix: dim the original network and draw super-nodes and super-edges bold.
Full-frame unlabelled colour grid with no network; hovering moves a crosshair (2.6%). Fix: show the origin and destination on an inset network and the path between them.
Hovered origin's reachable targets within the cutoff light on the network.
A lone decay curve on black (2% non-background), no axes. Fix: axes and the weights applied to a network neighbourhood beside the curve.
Closed roads under the ring and access loss on nodes; works.
Candidate sites and demand dots; dragging a site changes 0.6% and the readout stays near "backup 83%". Fix: light the demand that switches when the site moves.
Max flow to a placed sink with cut capacity; flows are thin.
K curve with a radius rule and a circle on the inset network; the circle is Euclidean.
Isochrone bands follow the placed origin; clear.
Sibling of network-inhomogeneous-k with an envelope; Euclidean circle glyph for a network distance.
Dim purple edges where density is hard to read; dragging an event changes 1.4%. Fix: brighter ramp, thicker edges, and the event's kernel footprint lit along the network.
Dense multi-coloured edges; the turn costs the pad sets are not visible as turns. Fix: show turn penalties at intersections around one route.
A small abstract star graph in the centre of the frame. Fix: lay the communities out on the street network or fit the graph to the frame.
Hop neighbourhood from a placed start lights the network; clear.
Nodes merge as the reach tolerance grows; small scene.
Cost from a placed source along roads; at one position "max cost 0.01" and the whole network draws white (see defects).
Demand tinted by access; dragging a facility changes 2% and tau, rho stay fixed. Fix: make the dragged facility's change in access visible (difference tint).
Service areas re-form as a facility is dragged; clear.
Snap links are invisible at card size among many points; the reach gives 0.050, 0.044, 0.050 (80% snapped). Fix: fewer points, bold snap links, and a wider distance range.
Degree-class bars; hovering a bar lights its intersections.
Hovering a bridge lights what it cuts off.
Kept roads light inside the speed window.
Arrival times along the network for a departure playhead; 3 of 5 distinct.

Tract means with the hovered tract's partial cells lit.

Pre and post fire as a curtain with a constructed post-fire scenario.

Break map with a tiny series inset; every probed cell reads "break at month 20" because the modeled pre/post-fire series share one break date. Fix: enlarge the series and vary the modeled break date across the map so the map and probe say something.
Sieved patches merge as the size threshold rises.
Modeled shape with its skeleton; stamping land changes the skeleton only a little (1.3%).

Muddy overlay of built-up raster and zones where input and output cannot be told apart; moving the peak keeps "largest target 472". Fix: show the redistributed counts on target zones with a fixed ramp and the built-up raster dimmed.
Channels from the threshold under the cursor; the rest picture has sparse dim channels.

One red blob on a grey field, points invisible; moving the window changes 1.4%. Fix: show Gi* z on a diverging ramp with cold spots and the window's neighbours lit.

Land-cover classes with a spotlight on the hovered class and metric bars.

Patches eroded by edge depth around the window.

Choropleth with a large white spotlight halo that washes out neighbours.
